question: Assume today is 2026-09-08. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the number of births registered in Taiwan in September 2026, as reported in the Ministry of the Interior's monthly household registration statistics.

target.what: Number of live births registered in Taiwan (Republic of China) during September 2026, as counted in the Ministry of the Interior's monthly household registration statistics (births registered in the month, by date of registration)
target.publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Republic of China (Taiwan) — Department of Household Registration, monthly statistics on household registration (人口統計/出生登記)
target.cadence: monthly, typically published in the following month (preliminary figures often released early in the following month)
target.caveats: Target period is future/incomplete relative to the 2026-09-08 cutoff: September 2026 has not yet occurred, so this is a forecast. Working interpretation: births by registration date in the month (flow), not by date of birth, and not year-to-date. Registration-date counts can differ from occurrence-d

candidates.hypothesis: September 2026 births ≈ recent monthly level adjusted for the September seasonal factor and the ongoing downward trend. September typically shows a modest seasonal pattern relative to August; the dominant driver is the multi-year decline in Taiwan births.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly registered births for Taiwan from 2019 through the latest month published before 2026-09-08 (ideally Jan–Jul 2026 and full 2023–2025), plus September values for 2019–2025 to estimate the September/August and September/annual ratios.

candidates.data_to_find: Monthly birth counts from DGBAS (中華民國統計資訊網) and any 2026 monthly population/birth releases through July or August 2026; also NDC population projection assumptions for 2026 births.

candidates.hypothesis: Births occurring in September 2026 were largely conceived around December 2025–January 2026; conception proxies (marriages, first-birth timing) and the number of women of childbearing age constrain the level. Occurrence-based counts approximate registration-based counts with a small lag.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly marriage registrations 2025–2026, number of women aged 25–39 (from MOI age structure), and any occurrence-based birth counts; parity/first-birth shares.

candidates.data_to_find: Monthly births for at least 2015–2025 to compute September/August ratios and their variability; the August 2026 registered births figure if published before 2026-09-08 (or the latest available month).

methods.rationale: Carries the latest observed monthly level (July 2026, 7,906) forward one month to August, then applies the September/August seasonal ratio. Dominant uncertainty is the unobserved August level and the seasonal ratio; both are assumption-driven. Fails if the 2026 decline accelerates sharply in August-September.

methods.rationale: Direct YoY route: September 2025 observed count (8,603) times a change factor anchored on the July 2026 -11.56% YoY decline (p21). Independent of the August 2026 gap but shares the trend assumption. Fails if the decline moderates or steepens materially.

assumptions.name: September/August registration ratio
assumptions.rationale: Historical Taiwan September/August registration ratios hover near 1.0 with modest scatter; 2025 was 8,603/8,939 = 0.962. A central 0.98 with a +/-8% band reflects typical month-to-month noise around a flat seasonal profile.
assumptions.applies_when: Applied to the latest observed August 2026 level to project September 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: A multi-year table showing a systematic September/August ratio far from 1.0.

assumptions.name: August 2026 level relative to July 2026
assumptions.rationale: No August 2026 figure is available; July 2026 was 7,906. Month-to-month variation in 2026 has been modest (May 6,832, June 7,324, July 7,906), so a central ratio of 1.0 with a +/-10% band is a reasonable bridge.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to carry the July 2026 observed level forward to August before applying the September ratio.
assumptions.falsified_by: An actual August 2026 count materially outside the 7,100-8,700 range.

assumptions.name: September 2026 YoY change factor vs September 2025
assumptions.rationale: July 2026 was -11.56% YoY (p21); the decline has been steepening through 2025-2026. A central factor of 0.90 with a band to 1.00 reflects continued but possibly moderating decline.
assumptions.applies_when: Applied to the September 2025 observed count (p4) to project September 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that the YoY decline has flattened or reversed in August-September 2026.

methods.rationale: Route d1: apply the observed 2026 YoY decline (July −11.56%, p21; 2025 annual −20%, p2) to the same-month prior-year value (September 2025 = 8,603). Seasonality is handled implicitly by using the same calendar month. Failure mode: if the 2026 decline steepens or flattens relative to July.

assumptions.name: September/August registration ratio
assumptions.rationale: Historical September/August registration ratios are near or slightly below 1.0 (2023: 10,717/12,016 = 0.89; 2025: 8,603/8,939 = 0.96). Central value 0.98 with a wide range spanning the observed 0.89-0.96 and modest upside.
assumptions.applies_when: The August 2026 level is known or proxied and the September seasonal pattern resembles recent years.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that September 2026 registrations were unusually boosted (e.g., a registration-deadline or subsidy effect) or that the seasonal ratio shifted well outside 0.90-1.06.

assumptions.name: August 2026 level relative to July 2026
assumptions.rationale: Month-to-month registration moves are modest; 2025 July→August was 8,939→8,464 (0.95) and 2023 July→August was 10,891→12,016 (1.10). Central 1.0 with ±10% range.
assumptions.applies_when: August 2026 is not yet observed and July 2026 is the latest available month.
assumptions.falsified_by: Publication of an August 2026 count far outside 0.90-1.10 of July's 7,906.

assumptions.name: September 2026 YoY change factor vs September 2025
assumptions.rationale: July 2026 was down 11.56% YoY (p21) and the 2025 annual decline was 20% (p2); recent months show a steepening decline. Central 0.90 (10% decline) with range 0.80-1.00 reflecting the ongoing downward trend and possible subsidy cushioning.
assumptions.applies_when: September 2026 continues the 2026 downward trend observed through July.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that the 2026 decline flattened or reversed (e.g., August 2026 YoY near zero or positive).

methods.rationale: Route d1: apply the observed 2026 YoY decline (July −11.56%, p21; 2025 annual −20%, p2) to the same-month prior-year value (September 2025 = 8,603). Seasonality is handled implicitly by using the same calendar month. Failure mode: if the 2026 decline steepens or flattens relative to July.

methods.label: m3
methods.rationale: Route d1: use the average of the three most recent observed 2026 months (May-July) as the current level, then apply the September/August seasonal ratio. Smooths month-to-month noise but assumes no further trend between July and September; overlaps heavily with m1.

kept.name: September/August registration ratio
kept.rationale: Historical September/August registration ratios are near or slightly below 1.0 (2023: 10,717/12,016 = 0.89; 2025: 8,603/8,939 = 0.96). Central value 0.98 with a wide range spanning the observed 0.89-0.96 and modest upside.
kept.applies_when: The August 2026 level is known or proxied and the September seasonal pattern resembles recent years.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that September 2026 registrations were unusually boosted (e.g., a registration-deadline or subsidy effect) or that the seasonal ratio shifted well outside 0.90-1.06.

kept.name: August 2026 level relative to July 2026
kept.rationale: Month-to-month registration moves are modest; 2025 July→August was 8,939→8,464 (0.95) and 2023 July→August was 10,891→12,016 (1.10). Central 1.0 with ±10% range.
kept.applies_when: August 2026 is not yet observed and July 2026 is the latest available month.
kept.falsified_by: Publication of an August 2026 count far outside 0.90-1.10 of July's 7,906.

kept.name: September 2026 YoY change factor vs September 2025
kept.rationale: July 2026 was down 11.56% YoY (p21) and the 2025 annual decline was 20% (p2); recent months show a steepening decline. Central 0.90 (10% decline) with range 0.80-1.00 reflecting the ongoing downward trend and possible subsidy cushioning.
kept.applies_when: September 2026 continues the 2026 downward trend observed through July.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that the 2026 decline flattened or reversed (e.g., August 2026 YoY near zero or positive).

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
